Lucide glyph colour is an override on the glyph vector: a pass copies the main's glyph colour into swapped glyphs inside nested Cupertino instances
Bound paints store the resolved alpha as paint.opacity; every set is reseeded (colour + alpha) in its Cupertino Light context
Set figma.skipInvisibleInstanceChildren=false in every script, or hidden instance parts are skipped and index-based name mirroring breaks
